EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 6
EPISODE LOGLINE: To reach the family vault that holds the ledger backup, Theo proposes a ninety-day contract engagement.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picking up at the Episode 5 cliffhanger: the chairman gives Nadia until Friday.
